sources: bloonswiki.com (via r.jina.ai): Line_of_sight, every tower page's stat tables ('Ignores blockers' filters, display range, footprint radius), every BTD6 map page and hero pages (fetched 2026-10-21)
Fandom Height page was CAPTCHA-blocked; Reddit/Steam not needed for LOS facts

conventions.progress: 0 = entrance, 1 = exit, learned from bloon motion order
conventions.segment_preference: [lo, hi] progress range where the tower performs best; null = irrelevant (no attack)
conventions.range_type: radius = attacks within display_range; global = map-wide (still LOS-limited if needs_line_of_sight); track_adjacent = places things on track inside its range
conventions.units: display_range / footprint_radius / support_radius are BTD6 game units (as on bloonswiki). null = unknown/not applicable. Convert with the bot's own unit->pixel scale.
conventions.footprint: small <= 6, medium 7-8, large >= 9 or rectangular (ace runway 28x18, heli pad 27x27)

line_of_sight.mechanic: Most towers can only target a bloon if a straight line from the tower to some part of the bloon is not blocked. Blockers are walls and objects, removables, and higher terrain: a tower cannot see bloons on ground higher than itself, but can see lower ground. Targeting is checked when an attack starts, so projectiles already in flight keep going. Most LOS projectiles are destroyed when they hit a blocker; some rebound (Juggernaut, Skywarden/Mermonkey ice balls) or pass through it (Glaive Ricochet glaives).
line_of_sight.how_to_see_it_in_game: When a tower is selected, or while it is being placed, the game shades the parts of its display range that are blocked in red (black with High Contrast / Color Blind). For snipers, blocked areas anywhere on the map are shaded. A bot can learn a per-cell LOS mask by hovering a tower ghost (a Sniper gives the whole map) over a candidate cell and diffing the screenshot against the normal range tint.
ignores_los_fully: spike (drops spikes behind blockers, but needs track inside its range)
ignores_los_with_upgrade: wizard Guided Magic (1-x-x): bolts seek through cover
wizard Summon Phoenix (x-4-x) and Lava Phoenix: infinite range, ignore blockers
wizard Necromancer (x-x-4): zombies ignore LOS; the graveyard collects through walls
sub Ballistic Missile (x-3-x) and Pre-emptive Strike: missiles fly over walls
boomerang MOAB Press heavy Kylie (x-x-4): targets through blockers
boomerang Glaive Ricochet (3-x-x): glaives pass through blockers, but targeting still needs LOS
druid Heart of Thunder (2-x-x): lightning chains through obstacles; Superstorm ignores walls
sniper Bouncing Bullet (x-3-x): the bounces ignore obstacles; S.P.I.D.E.R. paragon ignores LOS
skywarden Thundering Arc (x-2-x)+: fires over walls and gains Set Target
super X-ray Ultra Monkey Knowledge: sees and fires through blockers
beast_handler Giganotosaurus sees over all obstacles; birds of prey fly
dartling BADS/Rocket Storm/M.A.D. higher barrels pass over some low obstacles
etienne drones fly over blockers but only inside his range; UCAV missiles infinite range
admiral_brickell sea mines / Mega Mine ignore LOS
gwendolin Cocktail of Fire lands anywhere in range, even behind blockers
silas can attack inside an Ice Monkey's range without his own LOS (v50+)
mermonkey Final Harmonic totem pulls bloons through walls
partially_elevated_los: tack tier 4+ (Ring of Fire, Blade Maelstrom, Overdrive)
needs_los: ice (needs a visible target to trigger)
dartling (projectiles destroyed by blockers; Ray of Doom stops at obstacles)
benjamin Trojan (infinite range but cannot see through blockers)
special_immunity_zones: Quad trusses and Dark Castle entrance trees: bloons under them are IMMUNE to every attack, not just hidden
KartsNDarts tunnel: non-MOAB bloons inside cannot be targeted or damaged (MOABs fly over)
X Factor central barrack: blocks all attacks on bloons under it until the $2000 stack is removed
Mushroom Grotto darkness: bloons in unlit areas cannot be targeted (projectiles still hit); no placement in the dark
Logs: bloons under the logs CAN be hit by LOS-ignoring attacks

dart.los_exceptions: Projectiles are stopped by blockers, except Juggernaut balls, which rebound off them.
dart.notes: Cheap early DPS. Darts fly straight: a cell beside a straight lets missed darts continue along the track. Juggernaut / Ultra-Juggernaut (top path) balls rebound off walls: near walls on walled maps (Hedge, Encrypted, Dark Path, Moon Landing).

boomerang.los_exceptions: Glaive Ricochet glaives pass through blockers, but targeting still needs LOS. the heavy Kylie of MOAB Press (x-x-4) targets and attacks through blockers. Bionic Boomerang (x-3-x) LOS slightly elevated.
boomerang.notes: Base rangs arc counter-clockwise ('Monkey Special' flips to clockwise), so a curve hugging the arc helps. Glaive Ricochet (3-x-x) and Kylie (x-x-3+) throw in straight lines: beside a long straight, aimed along it. Glaive Lord orbiting glaives favour a loop center.

bomb.los_exceptions: The bomb needs LOS to fire; its explosion ignores blockers once it lands.
bomb.notes: Splash damage: place where bloons bunch up (bends, intersections, overlapping lanes). MOAB Mauler/Assassin (x-3/4-x) is single target, so any spot with LOS works.

tack.los_exceptions: Tier 4+ (Ring of Fire, Blade Maelstrom, Overdrive) have slightly elevated LOS. A Monkey Knowledge makes tacks rebound off obstacles.
tack.notes: Very short range (23). Maximise track length within range: tight curves, small loops, U-turns. Overdrive / Tack Zone kill zone sits right above the tower, so place inside a loop near its top edge. Ring of Fire / Inferno Ring want maximum track coverage (loop_center).

ice.los_exceptions: Needs a visible bloon to trigger; the freeze blast itself is flagged 'ignores blockers'. Cryo Cannon line has higher LOS.
ice.notes: Radial freeze/slow around itself (20): put it where the most track is within range, early on the track, so slowed bloons stay longer in other towers' ranges. Can go on water. Arctic Wind (x-3-x) lets land towers sit on nearby water.

glue.notes: Slow/stun support: first 30-50% of the track, so glued bloons spend longer in the damage zone. Corrosive/Liquefier glue pops over time, so it needs bloons glued early. Super Glue / Relentless Glue stuns belong at the main kill zone or chokepoint. Glue Storm ability is global.

desperado.los_exceptions: Targeting ignores bloons behind blockers; the bullets themselves are flagged 'ignores blockers'.
desperado.notes: Primary tower (v49): a pistol that fires 2-round bursts with 60 range (long for a primary). Paths: revolver (Quickdraw attacks faster the further the closest bloon is), long-range rifle with crits and bounties (Golden Justice: near-infinite pierce down long straights), or a close-range shotgun. Rifle builds want a long straight. Pistol: any cell with the most visible track within 60.

sniper.los_exceptions: Bouncing Bullet (x-3-x) bounces ignore obstacles. The S.P.I.D.E.R. paragon ignores LOS.
sniper.notes: Map-wide range, but every shot needs a clear straight line from the tower to the bloon. Choose the cell with the most visible track: open centre, raised platforms, away from walls. Elite Defender (x-x-5) attacks faster the further bloons are along the track. Set Strong for MOAB/DDT roles.

sub.los_exceptions: Main darts need LOS. Ballistic Missile missiles fly over walls. Low water on Ravine blocks normal sub darts.
sub.notes: Water only; darts seek. Use the water cell with the most track within 42. Advanced Intel (2-x-x) shoots inside other towers' ranges, but the darts still need the sub's own LOS. Submerge (3-x-x, Submerge targeting) reveals camo around itself and buffs water-tower abilities, but does not attack while submerged. Ballistic Missile (x-3-x) and First/Pre-emptive Strike ignore LOS.

buccaneer.los_exceptions: Ship guns follow normal LOS rules ?. Carrier/Flagship planes are flying and ignore blockers.
buccaneer.notes: Water only, two broadside guns. Best where the track runs on both sides of the water cell (central ponds, rivers between lanes). Aircraft Carrier (4-x-x) planes fly the whole map.

aiming.how: The plane flies a fixed pattern of about 80-unit radius around its runway; every pattern is 160*pi long. Centered Path (x-x-2) flies a 90-unit circle around a point set anywhere (it defaults to the map centre).
aiming.bot_safe: Leave Circle. Choose the runway cell whose 80-unit circle overlaps the most track. With Centered Path, set the point on the densest track region. Avoid Wingmonkey (it misbehaves on split lanes).

ace.notes: Flying: ignores all LOS blockers and elevation. The base attack fires 8 radial darts continuously with no targeting. Bomber Ace runs drop only while crossing the track. The runway footprint is a 28x18 rectangle.

aiming.how: The heli moves over the map. Follow Touch chases the mouse cursor, Lock in Place hovers at a chosen point, Patrol moves between two points, and Pursuit (Pursuit upgrade, path 1 tier 2) chases bloons automatically.
aiming.bot_safe: Buy Pursuit (2-x-x) early and select it. Before that, Lock in Place over the densest track point in the 0.1-0.5 progress range. Never leave it on Follow Touch, because the bot moves the mouse constantly. Pursuit gets confused on maps with 2 simultaneous lanes.

heli.notes: Flying: ignores LOS and elevation. A 42-unit detection circle moves with the heli. Excellent on alternating-lane, walled and elevated maps. Heli pad footprint is 27x27. The pad itself can go anywhere with space. The Support Chinook and Special Poperations abilities need clicks.

aiming.how: Fires at a reticle placed anywhere on the map with 18-unit random spread (8 with Increased Accuracy). The reticle stays put until moved.
aiming.bot_safe: Put the reticle once on the point with the most track cells within about 20 units: a tight bend, a loop, or a lane overlap, early-to-middle of the track. One fixed point is enough on a static map. For alternating lanes, pick an overlap or skip mortar.

mortar.notes: Lobbed: ignores all LOS blockers and elevation, and the pad can sit anywhere. Burny Stuff / Shattering Shells reward long tracks with wide bends. It also fires with no target in sight (works in Mushroom Grotto darkness).

aiming.how: The gun swivels toward the mouse cursor at 180 deg/s and fires constantly with 23 deg spread. Locked freezes the current aim. Bloon Area Denial System (x-x-4) adds automatic targeting.
aiming.bot_safe: Place it at the end of a long straight that runs away from the tower. Hover the cursor far along that straight, then click Locked. Otherwise only use it from x-x-4 BADS with Target Independent.

dartling.notes: Projectiles are destroyed by LOS blockers and the map edge. The Ray of Doom beam continues until it hits an obstacle. The higher barrels of Rocket Storm / M.A.D. / BADS pass over some low obstacles. It fires with no target (works in darkness).

wizard.los_exceptions: Guided Magic (1-x-x) bolts ignore blockers. Phoenix (x-4-x) and Lava Phoenix have infinite range and ignore blockers. Necromancer zombies ignore LOS, and its graveyard counts pops through walls.
wizard.notes: Guided Magic (1-x-x) bolts seek bloons behind cover: buy it first on walled maps. Wall of Fire (x-2-x) drops on the closest track point. Dragon's Breath (x-3-x) is a short flamethrower, so put it near a bend close to the track. Necromancer / Prince of Darkness zombies walk backwards from the exit and ignore LOS.

super.los_exceptions: Laser Blasts (1-x-x) and up have slightly elevated LOS. The X-ray Ultra Monkey Knowledge lets Supers see and fire through blockers.
super.notes: Huge DPS within 50: the cell with the most track in range (loop centres, spots where several passes overlap). Large footprint (radius 11), so reserve the space before cheaper towers crowd it.

ninja.notes: Camo detection. Seeking Shuriken (x-x-1) makes shurikens home. Grandmaster (5-x-x) gains +10 range and slightly higher LOS. Caltrops land on track within range (LOS-limited). Flash Bomb / Sticky Bomb have long range: any spot with LOS.

alchemist.notes: Potions ignore all LOS blockers. The buff path (Acidic Mixture Dip, Stronger Stimulant, Berserker Brew) targets towers inside its 45 range, so place it within 45 of the main damage towers. With no target in range it splashes acid on random track within range.

druid.los_exceptions: Heart of Thunder lightning jumps through obstacles; Superstorm projectiles ignore walls.
druid.notes: Thorns fire as a 5-shot spread, so dense track helps. Heart of Thunder lightning chains through obstacles. Druid of the Storm tornado blows bloons back. Spirit of the Forest vines cover the whole track. Poplust (x-x-4/5) buffs nearby Poplust druids, so cluster druids. Jungle's Bounty is income.

mermonkey.los_exceptions: Standard LOS for the trident; the song totem pull ignores walls.
mermonkey.notes: Magic tower (v44): splashing tridents. Range is 28 on land, +35% (about 38) on water, so prefer water cells next to the track. Lord of the Abyss (5-x-x) lets water towers be placed on land within its range (the reverse of Arctic Wind). The Final Harmonic song totem can be placed anywhere and pulls bloons through walls. Arctic Knight / Popseidon ice balls bounce off walls.

skywarden.los_exceptions: Thundering Arc (x-2-x) and up fire over walls and gain Set Target (fixed point within range).
skywarden.notes: Magic tower (v56). The bow ramps attack speed while it keeps hitting. Paths: wind (Aerial Attunement 1-x-x gives +range to itself and nearby towers), thunder, and ice. Combo debuffs reward several tier-3+ Skywardens of the same path placed together.

farm.notes: Income only, no attack. Place far from the track and from prime damage cells (corners, leftover space). Marketplace (x-x-3) auto-collects. Its range only matters for collection upgrades.

spike.notes: Drops spike piles on a random point of the track within 34. It attacks with no bloons nearby and can drop behind LOS blockers, but needs track in range. Last line of defence: place it so its range covers only the final ~15-25% of the track. Barely reaching the track makes piles denser. Smart Spikes (x-x-2) adds Close / Smart / Set Target / Automatic. Smart targets the track nearest the exit; Set Target can cover two exits at a split.

village.notes: No attack. It buffs towers inside its radius (+range, Radar Scanner camo, MIB, discounts, Jungle Drums attack speed). Place it at the centroid of the damage-tower cluster; it does not need to be near the track.

engineer.notes: The nail gun needs LOS. Sentries spawn on nearby land. Cleansing Foam (x-3-x) and Bloon Trap (x-x-4) are placed onto track within range (track_adjacent behaviour; the trap needs collecting). Overclock (x-4-x) is an ability that needs a target click. Sentry Gun is 1-x-x.

beast_handler.los_exceptions: The base staff attack ignores blockers. Bird and fish attacks come from the beast's position (birds fly).
beast_handler.notes: Support tower (v36) with a staff melee of 20 range that ignores LOS. Paths: (1) fish: Piranha needs water within 60 of the handler to be bought; the beasts jump from water at bloons. (2) dinosaurs: land beasts that can be repositioned in the handler's area; Giganotosaurus sees over all obstacles. (3) birds of prey: they fly, and Gyrfalcon / Giant Condor grab bloons and drop them at a reticle. Condor can merge two lanes. Several handlers merge into one beast (max 4 contributors). Placement: within range of the track bend the beast should cover; for the fish path, next to water.

quincy.notes: Bouncing arrows. Generic early carry: cell with the most track within 50 in the first 2/3 of the track. Storm of Arrows (lvl 10) and Rapid Shot are abilities; Storm of Arrows can target anywhere on the map.

gwendolin.los_exceptions: Cocktail of Fire / its burst ignore blockers
gwendolin.notes: Short-lived fire with splash: bends and dense track. The Cocktail of Fire target can be set anywhere in range, even behind blockers. Firestorm is global. Heat It Up buffs nearby towers.

striker_jones.los_exceptions: Bomb projectile needs LOS; its explosion ignores blockers
striker_jones.notes: Bomb hero. His Bomb/Mortar buffs and the black-bloon buff are GLOBAL, so placement only matters for his own attack (55). Concussive Shell and Artillery Command are abilities.

obyn.notes: Spirit wolf attack goes through solid obstacles. Nature's Wrath / Nature's Clarity buff Magic towers in his radius (+pierce, +5 range at lvl 11): place him inside the Magic cluster (druids, ninjas, wizards) near the main kill zone. Brambles / Wall of Trees drop on the track.

churchill.notes: Tank shells: high single-target damage; acquisition range about 65 (75 at higher level). MOAB Barrage targets up to 10 blimps anywhere on the map. Large footprint.

benjamin.notes: Income/support hero with no damage attack. Placement barely matters. Trojan (lvl 7) has infinite range but cannot see through blockers, and some players hide him behind a blocker to keep it from shrinking bloons. Put him on a spare cell away from prime spots.

ezili.notes: Instant-hit curse that targets over LOS blockers. Totem (78 range) placed inside her range. MOAB Hex / Sacrificial Totem are abilities; MOAB Hex is global.

pat_fusty.notes: Short range (30 at max): put him inside a tight bend near the front half. Rallying Roar buffs nearby towers. Big Squeeze grabs blimps. Large footprint.

adora.notes: Divine bolts seek and ignore LOS. Long Arm of Light (temporary huge range) and Ball of Light. She can sacrifice towers for XP. Place centrally for coverage; walls don't matter.

admiral_brickell.los_exceptions: Mines and their explosions ignore LOS; main gun follows normal LOS ?
admiral_brickell.notes: Water only. Sea mines drop on water within her range every 3 s and ignore LOS, but only hurt bloons passing near that water. Naval Tactics / water-tower buffs reach water towers in range (global at lvl 19). Mega Mine can go on any water. Place her in water close to the track and to the other water towers.

etienne.notes: Drones fly over blockers but only pursue bloons inside his range (55, later 60/80), so place him centrally with the most track inside 55. The lvl 8 UAV gives global camo detection. UCAV missiles have infinite range and ignore LOS. His range buff helps nearby towers.

sauda.los_exceptions: Slash projectile flagged 'ignores blockers'; targeting still needs LOS ?
sauda.notes: Melee with 23 range: needs the most track packed within 23, so loop centres, tight bends and overlapping lanes. Sword Charge hits overlapping lanes twice. Pairs with stuns (Relentless/Super Glue). Typical spot: inside the densest loop near the middle of the track.

psi.notes: Attacks anywhere on the map through blockers and sees camo. Placement only matters for the Psychic Blast ability radius (about Buccaneer range). Put Psi near the densest/most-overlapping track region.

geraldo.notes: Shop hero. Most items (turrets, idols, blade trap, Pet Rabbit) are placed by the player on or near the track. His own attack is modest. Not bot-friendly unless the item placement is scripted.

corvus.notes: The flying Spirit attacks anywhere on the map (ignores LOS). Corvus gains mana by haunting bloons near himself, so community placement is near the entrance/front of the track. Spells (Spear, Ancestral Might, ...) need active casting, which is not bot-friendly.

rosalia.notes: Placing her drops a workshop launch pad (60 range) and she hovers anywhere inside it. Her own attack range is 40. From lvl 7 the jetpack has no footprint. Discounts Aces and Helis.

silas.notes: Ice hero: placeable on land or water, slows bloons 15% within 30, and lets land towers be placed on water within 30 (Arctic Wind-like). He can attack inside any Ice Monkey's range, even out of his own LOS (since v50); the orb passes through blockers but he can't target behind them himself. Global freeze buffs. Never frozen on Glacial Trail. Place near Ice Monkeys / early track.

dan_dmonke.notes: Short range (30). Volant Strike / Reposition (lvl 7) let him move. Heals leaked lives at lvl 14. Never frozen on Glacial Trail. Place inside a dense bend.

Monkey Meadow.los_blockers: bushes at every corner except bottom-left (slight)
Monkey Meadow.best_spots: center of the map just below the top enclosed grass patch (widest coverage); generic map, track encloses top and bottom-left grass patches

In The Loop.los_blockers: autumn trees and wheelbarrow near top-right
In The Loop.special: square track with circular loops at bottom-right, top-right (water inside) and top-left corners
In The Loop.best_spots: central spot: long-range towers see 3+ pass-throughs; water towers in bottom-left of the top-right loop lake; short-range towers inside a corner loop

Tree Stump.los_blockers: tree stump, 3 logs and autumn trees
Tree Stump.elevation: towers ON the central stump are not blocked by any LOS blocker
Tree Stump.special: bloons loop once around the stump
Tree Stump.best_spots: on the central stump (good coverage, no LOS issues)

Town Center.special: short, spread-out track; one of the hardest beginner maps; ocean on the left (top-center/top-right ocean not placeable for water towers)

Middle of the Road.los_blockers: 6 buildings, water tower, windmill, parking station: most LOS-restricted beginner map
Middle of the Road.elevation: a tower placed on top of the water tower (top-right, fits up to Super Monkey size) is not LOS-blocked
Middle of the Road.special: entrance and exit at about the same spot on the left; small pool bottom-right for water towers; global-range towers excel
Middle of the Road.best_spots: on the water tower (top-right); otherwise prefer LOS-ignoring / global towers

One Two Tree.los_blockers: fences, top-corner trees, and closed tree spaces (each closed space is unplaceable + LOS blocker until it opens)
One Two Tree.special: 24 tree spaces on the lower half open at the end of specific rounds and give category-restricted buffs (Primary/Military/Magic/Support; 2 water-only snowmonkey spaces); bottom area fits only up to medium footprint
One Two Tree.best_spots: category spaces (e.g. +1 damage spaces for 1-damage towers); the free space unlocked at start; no single great coverage spot

Scrapyard.los_blockers: crusher near top and the central junk pile
Scrapyard.elevation: 4 boxes inside the junk are placeable (up to Super Monkey size) and high-elevation
Scrapyard.special: longest map; crusher gizmo (60 s cooldown) deals 6 dmg + 6 s stun to non-MOABs under it
Scrapyard.best_spots: top-left box for limited-range towers (multiple passes); keep room above/top-right of it for a Village; long-range towers on boxes

The Cabin.los_blockers: trees, car, cabin (trees also limit placement)
The Cabin.special: short, spread-out; hardest beginner map by consensus; pond in upper-middle split by a bridge
The Cabin.best_spots: the pond (water towers, wide coverage); global-range towers

Resort.special: 4th longest map; three nested clockwise rectangular loops; 2nd easiest map
Resort.best_spots: enclosed space top-right of the pool (9 track segments adjacent) - best for tack/ice/Sauda; pool between the two small loops for water towers; top straight for line attackers

Skates.los_blockers: 3 houses on the right (removable), corner trees (do not reach the track)
Skates.special: frozen lake; 2 ice cracks for water towers (large one in the center)
Skates.best_spots: left of the large middle loop for short/medium range towers; center ice crack for water towers; global towers

Lotus Island.elevation: towers on the stone podium are not LOS-blocked
Lotus Island.special: short, spread-out archipelago; lots of water; bottom-left island fits up to Super size, minor islands up to Spike Factory size
Lotus Island.best_spots: land: right of the lower-middle-center loop; water towers immediately left and right of that spot

Candy Falls.special: long map, vertical chocolate river down the middle (water placement); watermill blocks placement; two small loops (bottom-right, top-left)
Candy Falls.best_spots: river near the center (both sides of a boat see track); loops for short-range towers

Winter Park.elevation: towers can be placed on lamps, chairs, flower pots
Winter Park.special: 4 loops, one per quadrant; central fountain fits a few water towers
Winter Park.best_spots: left- or right-most point of the fountain (Buccaneer covers 4 sections); center-left / center-right land for medium-long range (3 sections)

Carved.los_blockers: two trees by the entrance and exit
Carved.special: jack-o'-lantern track; two eye ponds; cauldron on the right fits one water tower
Carved.best_spots: right eye pond; just below it; below the rightmost point of the mouth; below the mouth's connection to the border (tack: bloons pass twice over the kill zone)

Park Path.special: stream top-right to bottom-left with 4 water spots
Park Path.best_spots: central water spot (boats fire both sides); land immediately top / top-right of the central water spot covers entrance, middle and exit

Alpine Run.elevation: no LOS blockers despite the tall ski lift
Alpine Run.special: sharp 90-degree turns and long straights; dispersed
Alpine Run.best_spots: around the center of the middle lane; straight-line attackers

Frozen Over.elevation: high-elevation cliff at the top; widest part (middle-left) fits a Village/Super
Frozen Over.special: towers can go on ice, water and small icebergs (small/medium footprint)
Frozen Over.best_spots: close to the top of a loop for tack-type towers; left of the central water spot for long range

Cubism.special: 5th longest map; track wraps triangles, a quadrilateral and a hexagon; many intersections left of center
Cubism.best_spots: center and its immediate left (intersections); tack-type: near the top edge inside a small shape

Four Circles.special: running track with 4 circles; pools in the top-left and bottom-right circles
Four Circles.best_spots: central spot (covers 4 sectors and several straights)

Hedge.los_blockers: 3 hedges (small gaps in the left and right ones) and the central statue; edge walls bounce projectiles
Hedge.special: many up/down turns; small spaces between tracks (central spaces fit only small towers like Dart)
Hedge.best_spots: heli / LOS-ignoring towers; 3rd space between tracks from left or right looking through a hedge gap; behind the right hedge near the exit for Archmage

End Of The Road.special: shortest beginner map; entrance and exit adjacent around a pool
End Of The Road.best_spots: the pool (water towers see both sides); lots of open land

Logs.los_blockers: 6 hollow logs (bloons under logs can still be hit by LOS-ignoring towers)
Logs.special: 2nd longest and easiest map; small central pond fits 5 subs / 4 buccaneers
Logs.best_spots: central pond and land around the middle (many intersections)

Skull Tweak.los_blockers: the skull is a major LOS blocker (and unplaceable, as are the crevasses); the nest becomes a blocker in the Party Peak variant
Skull Tweak.special: added v55; 90-degree bends and straights; two lakes (top, and below the skull in 4 quadrants). Interacting with water spots/nest before R1 turns it into the harder 'Party Peak' layout (entrance moves to the skull's eyes) - the bot must not click those
Skull Tweak.best_spots: flying / LOS-ignoring towers (ace, heli, phoenix); water spots near the docks; bends on the bridges

Three Mines 'Round.los_blockers: 6 rocks with Bananite crystals and the top-left tent (block placement and LOS)
Three Mines 'Round.removables: Bananite crystal rocks (take 10 rounds to mine, 20 for the last; return more cash than cost): under loop $435 (+$435), left side $3000, inside loop bottom-right $10000, above loop $25000, inside loop top-left $50000, bottom-right corner $100000
Three Mines 'Round.special: track loops 3 times anticlockwise around the center (top -> bottom); dried river on the left with small puddles for water towers; one of the easiest maps
Three Mines 'Round.best_spots: spots next to where the loop passes intersect/overlap (center of the big loop is prone to chasing except for AoE); buy the $435 crystal early (profit)

Spa Pits.special: added v48; one long path looping clockwise around 4 outer hot springs and partially around the central pool; hot springs take water towers; edge plants block placement. Clicking the 4 loose rocks in order before R1 offers a much harder Tar Pits layout - the bot must not do this
Spa Pits.best_spots: spots adjacent to the central pool (save one for a Village); central pool for water towers / Bloontonium Reactor

Tinkerton.los_blockers: table, whiteboard, tree, top building, orange-juice containers
Tinkerton.elevation: bottom-left OJ container is placeable; the open OJ container near the center takes water towers
Tinkerton.removables: Rocket gizmo (one use after 11 clicks; 3 dmg + 50 dmg explosion + stun)
Tinkerton.special: added v43 (Rosalia's workshop); bloons slowed 40% after the top bend of the grass part; spread out
Tinkerton.best_spots: crater near the middle (sees 4 track sections); global towers

Lost Crevasse.los_blockers: column of ice crystals splitting the lower section; walls around the edges (bounce)
Lost Crevasse.special: two always-active paths that both run through the middle section in opposite directions; infobox says 3 entrances/3 exits ?
Lost Crevasse.best_spots: chokepoint at the front/middle where both lanes overlap (Sauda + glue); sniper right of the small crystal above the crystal column sees both sides

Luminous Cove.los_blockers: elevated pre-waterfall sections are out of LOS for most towers
Luminous Cove.elevation: pre-waterfall parts of both lanes are higher than the rest of the map: most towers cannot reach them
Luminous Cove.removables: Mermonkey secret reveals extra water (needs tier-5 Mermonkeys)
Luminous Cove.special: alternating lanes (odd rounds top-left -> bottom-right, even rounds top-right -> bottom-left); both loop through the center; mostly water
Luminous Cove.best_spots: central water spot inside the central loop (water strategies); heli/flagship for the elevated parts

Ancient Portal.los_blockers: the curved left exit path is surrounded by LOS blockers; the straight right exit path is visible from the entrance area

rules.rule: score(cell) = sum over track cells t within range r of w(progress(t)), where w is 1 inside segment_preference and falls off linearly to 0.3 at 0.25 progress outside it. Exclude t with known blocked LOS when needs_line_of_sight.

Count distinct track passes inside range: sort in-range track cells by progress and split wherever consecutive progress jumps by more than ~0.03. More passes means the same bloon is attacked several times (loops, U-turns, lanes passing next to each other). Bonus of about 0.15 * coverage per extra pass.

rules.applies_to: tack, sauda, pat_fusty, dan_dmonke, ninja, bomb, gwendolin
rules.rule: Maximise track length within a SHORT range (density). Prefer cells inside tight curves and small loops where the track wraps around the cell: angular coverage = fraction of 16 angle bins (around the cell) that contain in-range track cells; score *= (0.5 + angular_coverage).

rules.applies_to: tack Ring of Fire/Inferno, super, ice, sauda, village(for towers), druid
rules.rule: Prefer cells enclosed by track: cast 8 rays; count rays that hit track within 1.5*range. Score *= (0.6 + 0.4 * rays_hit/8).

rules.applies_to: boomerang (Glaive Ricochet/Kylie), dartling, desperado rifle, buccaneer, dart
rules.rule: Run PCA on the in-range track cells. Linearity = 1 - lambda_min/lambda_max. Prefer a cell beside (not on the axis of) a long straight: score *= (0.6 + 0.4 * linearity). For a Dartling, pick the straight whose direction points away from the tower and aim there once, then set Locked.
Water cell only. Bonus when in-range track lies on opposite sides of the cell: angular bins on both halves are occupied. Central ponds and rivers between lanes are ideal.

rules.applies_to: ice, glue, silas, druid of the storm, any stun/slow
rules.rule: Restrict to segment progress [0, 0.4] (glue up to 0.5). A slowed bloon spends longer in every later tower's range, so the slow must come before the main kill zone, not after.

Range must contain track with progress >= 0.75 (ideally the last 15%). Penalise in-range track with progress < 0.6, because spikes spread over all in-range track. Barely reaching the track is better than sitting on it. On shared or converging exits pick the convergence point; with Smart Spikes use Smart, or Set Target at a split.

Range is irrelevant. Score = fraction of track (weighted by segment_preference) visible from the cell, using the learned LOS mask; without a mask, prefer open cells far from map objects and on elevated platforms (map.elevation). Never place on low ground (Ravine river, Sunken Columns depressions, Mesa valley, Glacial Trail water, Quarry lower layers).

When map.los_blockers is heavy (Ravine, Hedge, Encrypted, Moon Landing, Another Brick, Dark Path, Castle Revenge, Flooded Valley, Peninsula, Dark Dungeons, Spillway, Middle of the Road, Water Park, Luminous Cove, Adora's Temple), prefer towers with needs_line_of_sight=false (alchemist, mortar, heli, ace, spike, obyn, adora, psi) or buy the LOS upgrade early (Guided Magic, Ballistic Missile).
If the in-game red/black blocked overlay is captured during placement preview, drop any cell where more than 40% of the in-range track is blocked. Re-check after a removable is bought.

rules.applies_to: village, alchemist buffs, obyn, etienne, rosalia, silas
rules.rule: Place the support so the most damage-tower footprints fall inside support_radius (village 40 with +range upgrades; alchemist 45, and its buff targets towers in range; Obyn buffs Magic towers in range). Score = sum of covered towers' value. The support itself needs no track coverage, except the alchemist when it is also an attacker.

Identify the top 1-2 'prime' cells (max passes*coverage). Reserve a radius-40 disk around the best one for the main carry plus Village plus Alchemist. Place early cheap towers outside the reserved footprint, or plan to sell them. Large footprints (super, village, farm, heli pad, ace runway, mortar) need the space reserved first.
Use the lowest-value cells: far from track and outside prime clusters. Range does not matter.
The pad/runway can go on any free large-footprint cell. Ace: choose the runway whose 80-unit flight circle overlaps the most track. Heli: Lock in Place, or Pursuit, over the densest track point.
The pad can be anywhere. Choose the target point p maximising the count of track cells within 20 units of p (tight loop or lane overlap), weighted toward progress [0.1, 0.7]. Set it once.

rules.applies_to: maps with lanes that alternate by round
rules.rule: Score a cell over ALL lanes: score = min over lanes of coverage (both lanes must be covered), or use towers that follow bloons (heli Pursuit, Corvus, global towers). Lanes are learned from bloon motion; record which lanes appear on which rounds.

Prefer cells where lanes overlap or converge (exit convergence on Dark Castle, Workshop, Enchanted Glade). Otherwise build one cluster per lane group (Quad top/bottom, Party Parade left/right). Heli Pursuit and Ace Wingmonkey get confused on split lanes.

rules.applies_to: Geared, Sanctuary, Covered Garden, Erosion, Glacial Trail
rules.rule: Coverage must be evaluated over the platform cycle (Geared 8/10 rounds, Sanctuary 24). Covered Garden: only the uncovered quarter is placeable, and towers there can't be upgraded once covered. Erosion: land collapses at the end of R17/35/53/71/89. Glacial Trail: a tower is frozen 2 of every 10 rounds counted from its own placement round, so stagger placements. Prefer global/position-independent towers on these maps.

rules.applies_to: Skull Tweak, Spa Pits, Flooded Valley, Luminous Cove, Polyphemus
rules.rule: Never click map props before or during R1. Some click sequences make the map harder (Party Peak, Tar Pits), flood towers (Flooded Valley $5000 breach, which needs a confirm), or cost cash. The probe/placement code should avoid clicking the listed hotspots.
